Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Isis Moren: 39-year-old woman, 173 cm (medium), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: square compact face; full cheeks and sharply defined brows; crooked healed nose, balanced mouth; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blue-teal, bun-topknot-wrapped, deliberate accent: offset gathered mass. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette teal-brown. Visible personal details: a narrow tattoo cuff; a hand-painted hem mark; one mismatched earring. Make stitching, quilting, embroidery, or woven pattern the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: balances one confident color field against quiet neutrals. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a small empty medicine pouch only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
